method.latency: scheduled arrival to complete response, including sender lag; failed outcomes retained
method.throughput: correct responses / (last recorded completion - first scheduled arrival), not capacity
method.memory: common request-window sampled controller + worker RSS; shared pages may count twice; excludes load generator. Direct mode retains idle controller; lifecycle peak recorded separately.
method.transport: load client uses keep-alive; gateway upstream connections close after each request; health probes have a separate connection pool; no retries
method.scope: synthetic HTTP demo with asynchronous delay, not CPU-bound work; offered load only, not capacity or zero-downtime proof
